name: Tomorrow.io MCP
description: Gets real-time, forecast, historical and route weather data plus natural-language weather answers for AI agents through Tomorrow.io's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Current Weather
skills.description: Returns current temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, visibility and UV index for a coordinate or place name.

skills.name: Weather Forecast
skills.description: Retrieves a weather forecast timeline over a chosen time range for a location, such as rain over the next six hours.

skills.name: Historical Weather
skills.description: Looks up past observed weather and long-term climate normals for a location to compare against today.

skills.name: Weather Events and Routes
skills.description: Builds condition-based weather event timelines for a place or along a route to flag weather risk.

skills.name: Ask About the Weather
skills.description: Answers free-text weather questions and writes weather summaries in natural language using Tomorrow.io's Gale AI.
